name: University of Plymouth

settingEvidence.evidence: right at the heart of Plymouth, just across the street from the city

fees.text: £10,050 per year for UK students starting in 2027-28 (2026-27: £9,790). Plymouth says tuition fees from 2028/29 will rise automatically each year in line with inflation, so the fee for a September 2028 start is not published yet. An optional placement year costs £2,010 in the UK in 2027-28.

source.evidence: £10,050 per year

livingCosts.text: University halls cost about £141 (shared facilities) to £233 (en suite) a week, including all utility bills, WiFi and contents insurance (2026/27 prices; 2027/28 prices are not published yet).

openDays.text: Next undergraduate open days (on campus, 9am to 3:30pm): 14 November 2026, 24 April 2027 and 19 June 2027.

contextual.summary: If one or more of Plymouth's criteria apply to you (for example free school meals, time in care, an IMD Quintile 1 postcode or a listed South West/Wales school), a lower contextual offer may be applied automatically.
contextual.typicalReduction: Typically 8 UCAS points below the advertised tariff on the business school courses; Plymouth says up to three grades below the standard offer

criteria.detail: You have spent three months or more in local authority care (tick the care question on your UCAS application).
You attend a state secondary school and are or have been eligible for free school meals.
You have refugee status or humanitarian protection.
You are from a military family: either or both of your parents have served in the UK Armed Forces.
You have ever served in the UK Armed Forces.
You are a member of the Gypsy, Traveller, Roma, Showmen or Boater communities.
You are aged 18 to 24 and not communicating with, or supported by, either parent or carer because of an irreconcilable breakdown (this includes parents or carers who have died or can't be traced).
You attend a non-selective state school or college in the South West/Wales region on Plymouth's list of schools.
You come from an area in Indices of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Quintile 1; the page has a postcode checker.

contextual.rulesText: If one or more of the criteria applies to you, a contextual offer may automatically be applied by the Admissions team (you do not need to do anything else). Plymouth uses the widening access questions on the UCAS form. Meeting a criterion does not guarantee an offer. The page says contextual offers are not available for foundation year degrees or programmes with mandatory placements or capped numbers (including medicine and dentistry).

source.evidence: If one or more of the following statements applies to you, a contextual offer may automatically be applied by our Admissions team:
